profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer

Programming Languages:
 - Golang
 - Java (Akka, Jetty, Swing, Struts, JSP, EJB, Hibernate)
 - JavaScript (NodeJs, AngularJs, Bootstrap, Jquery)
 - Python
- Solidity
 

Cloud Computing
 - AWS
 - Google Cloud Platform

Databases:
 - H2, Oracle, MySQL
 - DynamoDB

Other:
 - Blockchain (Ethereum, Hyperledger)
 - Docker
 - Git
 - REST
 - Vagrant, Packer, Ansible
 - Nginx
 - Jenkins, Team City
 - JIRA
 - Consul
 - Agile
 - Excellent communicator, Team player

Personal Interests:
 - IPFS
 - Plan9

positions.title: Director of Engineering, Office of the CTO
Principal engineer and Technical Lead
positions.description:
Principal Architect and core contributor to project TIBCO Flogo, a Framework for IoT Edge Apps & Integration.
Also leading TIBCO's blockchain innovation lab.

Responsibilities:
- Design and Implementation of features for Flogo engine for IoT, Cloud and Serverless environments.
- Define Blockchain vision and strategy.
- Lead architecture and development of Blockchain use cases.

Key Skills:
- Golang expert
- Docker expert
- Bizantine Fault Tolerant Algorithms proficient
- Ethereum  proficient
- Hyperledger proficient

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently working as a Senior Software Architect as part of a distributed team to develop a cloud platform based on microservices architecture to host an IPaaS solution.

Responsibilities:
- Design systems architecture including (CI/CD, microservices, cloud infrastructure and testing)
- Design of REST APIs for microservices using Swagger.
- Analysis, design and implementation of container layer for microservices using Docker.
- Analysis, design and implementation of microservices using Golang, Java, NodeJs

Key Skills:
- Golang proficient
- NodeJs proficient
- AWS (Cloud Formation) proficient
- Docker proficient
- Vagrant proficient
- Ansible proficient
- Nginx proficient
- DynamoDB proficient

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Software Architect as part of a distributed team to develop a centralized administrative	interface to manage	 and	monitor multiple TIBCO products (Tibco Enterprise Administrator).

Responsibilities:
- Analysis, design and implementation of Server (Java Akka) and Client (AngularJs) side.
- Analysis, design and implementation of REST API between server and client side.

Key Skills:
- Java expert (Akka, Jetty, Jackson)
- JavaScript proficient (AngularJs, Jquery, Bootstrap)
- REST proficient
- H2 DDBB proficient
- Jenkins expert
- Junit expert

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Eclipse RPC plugin developer specialist.

Project AMX Service Grid (SOA).
Project AMX Decisions (Decision Rules).
Project BPM (Business Process Modelling).

Responsibilities:
- Analysis and Design of modelling solutions
- Implementation and Integration of Eclipse RPC plugins

Key Skills:
- Java expert
- Eclipse Modelling Framework (EMF)
- Eclipse Graphical Modelling Framework (GMF)
- Xml expert
- SOA
- BPM
- ANTL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
MDA (Model Driven Architecture) specialist.

The project consisted in the creation of a modelling tool that would allow the user to enter use cases and through MDA transformations generation of deployable applications.

Responsibilities:

- Design, Implementation and integration of Use Case Framework using MDA, 
- Design and Implementation of Metamodels (OptimalJ), 
- Implementation of MDA transformations (Java, TPL), 
- Configuration of the application server.
